label: PlanetScale
description: PlanetScale service tokens, OAuth tokens, database passwords, and connection hosts.

signals.reason: A service token (pscale_tkn_) calls the PlanetScale API with the permissions that the owner gave it.
An OAuth token (pscale_oauth_) calls the PlanetScale API for a user.
A database password (pscale_pw_) connects to one branch with the role of the password.
The item name or a label names PlanetScale.
A host of the item is a PlanetScale host.
